name: Dutch church buildings (Kerkgebouwen in Nederland)
title: Dutch church buildings (Kerkgebouwen in Nederland)
description: Comprehensive directory of church buildings, chapels, basilicas, cathedrals, and synagogues in the Netherlands (including Bonaire and Saba). Aggregates Catholic (6 dioceses + Aartsbisdom Utrecht), Protestant (Hervormd, Gereformeerd, Doopsgezind, Luthers, Waals, etc.), Oud-katholiek, Russisch-orthodox, and Jewish places of worship — plus historical (voormalig/verdwenen) and ruined churches (kerkruïnes). Resolved to Wikidata QIDs with multilingual names (39 languages), descriptions, geocoordinates, Wikimedia Commons images, year of inception, Rijksmonument heritage IDs, and links to Wikipedia in 35 languages.

meta.description: Comprehensive directory of church buildings, chapels, basilicas, cathedrals, and synagogues in the Netherlands (including Bonaire and Saba). Aggregates Catholic (6 dioceses + Aartsbisdom Utrecht), Protestant (Hervormd, Gereformeerd, Doopsgezind, Luthers, Waals, etc.), Oud-katholiek, Russisch-orthodox, and Jewish places of worship — plus historical (voormalig/verdwenen) and ruined churches (kerkruïnes). Resolved to Wikidata QIDs with multilingual names (39 languages), descriptions, geocoordinates, Wikimedia Commons images, year of inception, Rijksmonument heritage IDs, and links to Wikipedia in 35 languages. Bevat 2780 records. Downloaden in Excel, CSV, PDF formaat.
